reference.title: Data Breach Examples
reference.shortdesc: Examples of data breaches in higher education institutions, along with the times of the breach, when they were reported, and how many people were affected.

section.title: Examples of University Data Breaches
section.p: Data breaches affect both small and large audiences depending on the nature of the breach. Consider the following examples from universities to understand how data breaches affect thousands of users in some cases, and only a handful of users in others.

strow.stentry: University of Illinois College of Medicine
